passages.text: COMMENT Excluded from Algeria. According to Ros et al. (2013), this species was erroneously listed by Ros et al. (1999) for Algeria caused by a misinterpretation of the name Hypnum cupressiforme var. uncinatum Boulay, which in fact is a synonym of Hypnum cupressiforme var. cupressiforme and not of Hypnum uncinulatum.
